verdict.rationale: Slack ships an extensively documented Web API and Events API, an OpenAPI spec repo, an official CLI/SDKs, and a live keyless-reachable test endpoint confirming the API is real and callable, giving AI-native users clear, documented programmatic access. missing for 10: no independent third-party hands-on report of a full agentic workflow built purely against the public API (only first-party docs and probes).
